title: JumpCloud - Customer Success Manager - India
snippet: Title: JumpCloud - Customer Success Manager - India ## Customer Success Manager - India. ### About JumpCloud®. ### **About the Role**. We are seeking an experienced **Customer Success Manager** based in **India (Remote)** to own the end-to-end post-sales technical success for a strategic portfolio of APAC / EMEA based **Enterprise and high-value Commercial customers**. This is a **technical-first, strategic advisory role** that combines deep hands-on product expertise with long-term customer outcome ownership. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor to our customers, ranging from hands-on IT Admins and Systems Engineers to CISOs, Directors, and VPs of IT and Compliance. You will partner closely with Account Managers, Support, Product, Engineering, and Solutions Architecture teams to drive product utilization, customer health, rapid onboarding, and gross/net retention across the JumpCloud platform. **Portfolio & Lifecycle Ownership:** Own the post-sales success plan for an assigned portfolio of Enterprise and Commercial accounts, aligning JumpCloud features directly with client business objectives. **Trusted Technical Advisor:** Serve as the strategic advisor for IT administrators, Security Operations, and Executive Sponsors on identity, access, device management, and Zero Trust best practices. **Onboarding & Time-to-Value (TTV):** Lead complex technical onboarding, deployment architectures, feature rollouts, and change management strategies to ensure rapid time-to-value. **Health & Telemetry Monitoring:** Proactively analyze account usage data, deployment health signals, and platform telemetry (leveraging AI-driven insights and health dashboards) to identify adoption risks or unused features. Partner with Support, Product, and Engineering to diagnose root causes and expedite resolution. **Executive & Technical Business Reviews (EBRs/QBRs):** Prepare and conduct regular value-driven reviews with executive and technical stakeholders, demonstrating ROI, security improvement, and product roadmap alignment. **Growth Collaboration (CSQLs):** Identify new technical use cases, expanding user bases, or add-on product opportunities and collaborating with Account Managers to drive expansion. **Voice of the Customer:** Advocate for customer requirements by channeling technical feedback, feature requests, and bug patterns directly into Product and Engineering roadmaps. **Experience:** 5+ years of customer-facing technical experience in SaaS (Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services), with at least **3+ years in a dedicated technical capacity**. **Prior JumpCloud or Admin Experience:** Direct experience administering JumpCloud, or hands-on experience as a SysAdmin/IT Manager.
